CBSE CLASS XII Latest Updates

08 Oct, 2026 CBSE Datesheet Class 12 2027 Out Soon; Check Live Updates Here.

24 Sep, 2026 CBSE Sample Question Papers and Marking Schemes for Class 12 Released, Check Here.

The CBSE Class 12 syllabus 2027 is released by the Central Board of Secondary Education (CBSE). The CBSE 12th syllabus 2027 consists of Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Biotechnology, Physical Education, and many more subjects. The CBSE Class 12 syllabus 2027 PDF download link is available at cbseacademic.nic.in.

The CBSE 12th syllabus 2027 consists of 5 main subjects as compulsory papers and 1 optional subject.
The CBSE Class 12 syllabus 2027 topics for Maths cover Sets & Functions, Algebra, Coordinate Geometry, Calculus, and Statistics & Probability.
The CBSE Physics syllabus 2027 important topics are Electromagnetic Waves, Electromagnetic Induction, Alternating Current, and Current Electricity.
Some of the CBSE Class 12 syllabus 2027 important topics for Chemistry are Electrochemistry, Aldehydes, Ketones, and Carboxylic Acids.
The Mathematics, English, Hindi, Accountancy, Business Studies, Economics, and Political Science theory paper carries 80 marks, whereas the practical carries 20 marks each.
The Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, and Information Practices theory paper carries 70 marks, and the practical carries 30 marks each.

As per the CBSE Class 12 syllabus, the exam is conducted in a single term. No changes have been announced yet for the CBSE Class 12 syllabus 2027.

Direct Link to Check and Download CBSE Class 12 Syllabus PDF 2027

Key Summary
The CBSE Class 12 study material includes NCERT. The syllabus is important for JEE Main, CUET, NEET, and CLAT exams also.
The CBSE Class 12 exam 2027 will take place in offline mode for 3 hours.
The CBSE Class 12 2027 exam contains 50% competency-based questions, 20% select-response types, and 30% constructed response.
The CBSE Class 12 exam preparation tips include: learning basic concepts of the topics, focusing on high-weightage topics, preparing notes, solving previous year papers, appearing for mock tests, analysing your performance, and learning time management.
